backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Article and UserProfile types, CRUD operations for articles, admin registration/authorization logic, blob storage mixin, and access control integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming the removal of the 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution from the Footer component, with high confidence and a reference to Footer.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose and notable recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the FX Colonel app, loading Roboto from Google Fonts, setting the favicon to the FX Colonel Pips Network logo, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with a Layout shell (Header, Footer, Toaster) and three routes: LandingPage, AdminDashboard, and ApiReferencePage.
frontend/src/components/ArticleCard.tsx: Article card UI component that displays cover image (via ExternalBlob.getDirectURL()), keywords, title, excerpt, and metadata with hover animations and an optional draft badge.
frontend/src/components/ArticleDetailMod: Responsive article detail modal with bottom-sheet behavior on mobile, swipe-to-close limited to the drag handle area, sanitized HTML body rendering, and cover image support via ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/ArticleEditor.ts: A rich-text article editor component supporting title, slug, author, content (via ReactQuill), SEO keywords, cover image, and additional inline images with upload progress, draft/publish saving, and copy-URL functionality.
Displays a searchable, filterable list of articles with stats (total/published/drafts) and per-article actions for editing, toggling publish status, and deleting, with inline success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmationModa: An animated modal dialog that prompts the user to confirm a destructive action, showing a title, message, cancel button, and a configurable confirm button with a loading state.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer component rendering the brand logo, navigation links, a trading risk disclaimer, and a dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky site header with logo, desktop and mobile navigation links (including a conditional admin dashboard link), and an Internet Identity login/logout button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageSetting: Admin settings panel for updating the homepage hero image, supporting both direct URL input and file upload (converted to a data URL), with a live preview and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name on first login, saving the profile via the `useSaveCallerUserProfile` mutation with animated open/close transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries accordingly.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook that manage ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and persisted identity restoration via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the app, covering published/draft article fetching, search, hero image management, admin checks, and user profile CRUD operations against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining a dark gold-and-navy design token system (CSS custom properties) and custom styles for inputs, autofill, and the Quill rich-text editor.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrappers around the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: The admin dashboard page that handles authentication gating, displays article stats, and renders either an article list view or editor view, along with hero image settings and a first-time profile setup modal.
frontend/src/pages/ApiReferencePage.tsx: Renders a styled API reference page with reusable CodeBlock, Section, and EndpointCard components, documenting backend canister query/update endpoints with copy-able TypeScript examples.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Main public-facing page displaying a hero section with a dynamic background image, a debounced search input, and a paginated grid of published articles with a detail modal.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides utility functions for stripping HTML, formatting bigint nanosecond timestamps to readable dates, truncating text, and computing relative date strings.
frontend/src/utils/slugify.ts: Exports a single slugify function that converts a string to a URL-friendly lowercase hyphenated slug.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with CSS-variable-based custom colors (gold, navy, charcoal, etc.), custom fonts, border radii, box shadows, and enabling the animate and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and feature request state, recording one completed feature and one pending request both related to removing the 'Built with caffeine.ai' footer attribution.
